title: Vault
subtitle: Personal budget tracker for Android and iOS, built on Kotlin Multiplatform.

sections.description: Vault tracks income and expenses, budgets and savings goals in one place, with insights that show where your money goes. Domain models, use cases and preferences live in a shared Kotlin Multiplatform module; the Android app is built with Jetpack Compose and the iOS app with SwiftUI.
features: Track income and expenses with a quick add-transaction flow
Activity tab with your transaction history
Budgets and savings goals with progress tracking
Local-first storage with Room and optional Firebase sync
Google sign-in (Credential Manager) and biometric lock
Home-screen widgets on Android (Glance) and iOS (WidgetKit)
One floating tab bar design language across both platforms

sections.description: Business logic is written once in Kotlin and shared between platforms, while each platform keeps a fully native UI: Jetpack Compose on Android, SwiftUI on iOS.
features: Domain models, use cases and preferences in a shared module
A single design language for both platforms
